## 1、**DC04PE04**有序输出哈希表中的所有关键字

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
void PrintKeys(HashTable ht, void(*print)(StrKeyType)){
/* 请调用形参中的print函数输出关键字 */

for (int i = 1; i <= 26; i++) {
    int defaultHash=i-1;
    for (int j = 0; j < ht.size; j++) {
        int pos=(j+defaultHash)%ht.size;
        RcdType2 temp=ht.rcd[pos];
        if (temp.tag==1&&temp.key[0]-'A'+1==i) {
            print(temp.key);
        }
    }


}


}
```

## 2、**DC04PE15**链地址哈希表的构造

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int BuildHashTab(ChainHashTab &H, int n, HKeyType es[])
{  // Add your code here

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c=es[i];
        int hash=Hash(H,c);
        // printf("%d %c",hash,c);
        HLink k=(HLink)malloc(sizeof(struct HNode));
        k->data=c;
        k->next=NULL;
        if (H.rcd[hash]==NULL) {
            // printf("%d--%c  ",i,k->data);
            H.rcd[hash]=k;
        } else {
            // printf("  %d++%c",i,k->data);
            int sign=0;
            HLink p = H.rcd[hash];  
            while (p!=NULL) {
                if (p->data==k->data) {
                    sign=1;
                    break;
                }
                p=p->next;
            }
            if (sign==0) {
                p=H.rcd[hash]; 
                H.rcd[hash] = k;        
                H.rcd[hash]->next = p;  
                
            }
            
        }
         H.count++;
    }
    
    return SUCCESS;
}
```

## 3、**DC04PE35**在链地址哈希表中查找关键字，并记录查找过程中发生的冲突次数

```
#include "allinclude.h"
Node* searchLHash(LHashTable H, KeyType key, int &c)
{
	int ans=0,sign=0;
	for (int i = 0; i < H.size; i++) {
		Node *p=H.rcd[i];
		Node *res=NULL;
		ans=0;
		sign=0;
		while (p!=NULL) {
			if (p->r.key==key) {
				res=p;
				sign=1;
			}
			if (sign==0) {
				ans++;
			}
			p=p->next;
		}
		if (sign==1) {
			c=ans;
			return res;
		}
	}



	return NULL;  //Temporary code. Modify it if necessary.
}
```
